mentions.name: BuildOpsy
mentions.description: BuildOpsy is a site publishing articles on system design, infrastructure failures, and outage postmortems, along with calculators for engineering calculations that engineers otherwise work out in spreadsheets late at night.
mentions.problem: Engineers typically calculate these values by hand in a spreadsheet, often late at night.
mentions.source_excerpt:
been building BuildOpsy mostly writing about system design, infrastructure failures and the occasional “well, that was an expensive outage” postmortem.

Also building calculators for things engineers usually calculate in a spreadsheet at 2am.
